+
+/// The first failed child's stored failure reason for a refused sub —
+/// resolved sub -> plan -> failed task -> child run state, so the campaign
+/// surface can say WHY instead of only WHICH.
+fn sub_failure_summary(
+    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
+    campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign,
+    sub_id: &str,
+) -> Option<String> {
+    let sub = campaign.sub_goals.iter().find(|sub| sub.sub_id == sub_id)?;
+    // sub_plan_id is only persisted on merge; a refused sub's plan id lives in
+    // the launch sidecar its sub-orchestrator wrote before failing.
+    let plan_id = sub.sub_plan_id.clone().or_else(|| {
+        let launch_dir = paths
+            .home()
+            .join("plans")
+            .join(&campaign.campaign_id)
+            .join("launch")
+            .join(sub_id);
+        deadreckon_core::campaign::read_sub_result(&launch_dir)
+            .ok()
+            .flatten()
+            .and_then(|result| result.plan_id)
+    })?;
+    let plan = deadreckon_core::plan::load_plan(paths, &plan_id).ok()?;
+    // A failed task is the usual shape, but a kill or cap can leave the task
+    // recorded as running — so any non-completed task whose child run stored a
+    // failure or pause reason explains the refusal.
+    let (task, reason) = plan
+        .tasks
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|task| task.status != deadreckon_core::plan::PlanTaskStatus::Completed)
+        .find_map(|task| {
+            let run_id = task.child_run_id.as_deref()?;
+            child_failure_reason(paths, run_id).map(|reason| (task, reason))
+        })?;
+    Some(format!("{sub_id}: child {} — {reason}", task.index))
 }

=== DIFF: crates/deadreckon/src/failure_surfacing_tests.rs ===
@@ -0,0 +1,186 @@
+//! Failure-cause bubbling: plan- and campaign-level refusal surfaces must
+//! name the underlying child failure reason (one hop away in state.json)
+//! instead of only their own layer's status, and provider quota limits are
+//! surfaced as resumable rather than generically failed.
+
+use super::*;
+use deadreckon_core::campaign::{Campaign, build_rollup, build_sub_goals};
+use deadreckon_core::plan::{
+    Plan, PlanMode, PlanProviders, PlanRole, PlanTask, PlanTaskStatus, save_plan,
+};
+use deadreckon_core::state::{RunOptions, RunStatus, create_run, save_state};
+use tempfile::TempDir;
+
+const QUOTA_REASON: &str = "provider error: CLI provider error for cli:claude-code: subprocess exited with Some(1): You've hit your session limit · resets 10:50pm (America/New_York)";
+
+fn temp_paths() -> (TempDir, DeadreckonPaths) {
+    let temp = TempDir::new().expect("tempdir");
+    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::from_home(temp.path().join("home"));
+    (temp, paths)
+}
+
+fn failed_child_run(temp: &TempDir, paths: &DeadreckonPaths, reason: &str) -> String {
+    let mut state = create_run(
+        paths,
+        RunOptions {
+            goal: "child work".to_string(),
+            cwd: temp.path().to_path_buf(),
+            sandbox: "none".to_string(),
+            provider: Some("cli:claude-code".to_string()),
+            skill_name: "default-coding".to_string(),
+            max_spend_usd: Some(1.0),
+            max_wall_seconds: None,
+            run_id: None,
+            codebase: None,
+        },
+    )
+    .expect("run");
+    state.status = RunStatus::Failed;
+    state.failure_reason = Some(reason.to_string());
+    save_state(&state).expect("save state");
+    state.run_id
+}
+
+fn plan_with_failed_child(child_run_id: Option<String>) -> Plan {
+    let mut failed = PlanTask::new(
+        0,
+        "Task 0".to_string(),
+        "Do child 0".to_string(),
+        PlanRole::Child,
+        Some("cli:claude-code".to_string()),
+    );
+    failed.status = PlanTaskStatus::Failed;
+    failed.child_run_id = child_run_id;
+    let pending = PlanTask::new(
+        1,
+        "Task 1".to_string(),
+        "Do child 1".to_string(),
+        PlanRole::Child,
+        Some("cli:claude-code".to_string()),
+    );
+    Plan::new(
+        "build the app",
+        PlanMode::FullPlan,
+        vec![failed, pending],
+        PlanProviders::default(),
+        Some("scope".to_string()),
+        "0.1.0",
+    )
+    .expect("plan")
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn merge_paused_surface_names_child_failure_reason_and_quota_resume() {
+    let (temp, paths) = temp_paths();
+    let run_id = failed_child_run(&temp, &paths, QUOTA_REASON);
+    let plan = plan_with_failed_child(Some(run_id.clone()));
+
+    let rendered = commands::merge::merge_incomplete_plan_surface(&paths, &plan, &plan.tasks[0])
+        .render_plain(false);
+
+    assert!(rendered.contains("session limit"), "{rendered}");
+    let child = run_prefix(&run_id);
+    assert!(
+        rendered.contains(&format!("deadreckon show {child} --why-failed")),
+        "{rendered}"
+    );
+    assert!(
+        rendered.contains(&format!("deadreckon resume {child}")),
+        "a quota-limited child is resumable, not dead: {rendered}"
+    );
+    assert!(rendered.contains("resets 10:50pm"), "{rendered}");
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn merge_paused_surface_without_child_run_keeps_attach_primary() {
+    let (_temp, paths) = temp_paths();
+    let plan = plan_with_failed_child(None);
+
+    let rendered = commands::merge::merge_incomplete_plan_surface(&paths, &plan, &plan.tasks[0])
+        .render_plain(false);
+
+    assert!(
+        rendered.contains(&format!("deadreckon attach {}", run_prefix(&plan.plan_id))),
+        "{rendered}"
+    );
+    assert!(!rendered.contains("reason"), "{rendered}");
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn campaign_why_failed_names_per_sub_child_failure_reason() {
+    let (temp, paths) = temp_paths();
+    let run_id = failed_child_run(&temp, &paths, QUOTA_REASON);
+    let plan = plan_with_failed_child(Some(run_id));
+    save_plan(&paths, &plan).expect("save plan");
+
+    let subs = build_sub_goals(
+        vec!["rebuild billing".to_string(), "rebuild docs".to_string()],
+        2,
+    )
+    .expect("subs");
+    let mut campaign = Campaign::new(
+        "rebuild everything",
+        subs,
+        PlanProviders::default(),
+        0,
+        Some(10.0),
+        None,
+        "0.1.0",
+    )
+    .expect("campaign");
+    // Mirror the real failure shape: a refused sub never gets sub_plan_id
+    // persisted; only its launch sidecar names the plan it ran.
+    let launch_dir = paths
+        .home()
+        .join("plans")
+        .join(&campaign.campaign_id)
+        .join("launch")
+        .join(&campaign.sub_goals[0].sub_id);
+    std::fs::create_dir_all(&launch_dir).expect("launch dir");
+    deadreckon_core::campaign::write_sub_result(
+        &launch_dir,
+        &deadreckon_core::campaign::SubResult {
+            schema_version: 1,
+            sub_id: campaign.sub_goals[0].sub_id.clone(),
+            plan_id: Some(plan.plan_id.clone()),
+            result_run_id: None,
+            ok: false,
+        },
+    )
+    .expect("sub result");
+    campaign.sub_goals[1].result_run_id = Some("run-1".to_string());
+    let rollup = build_rollup(&campaign, |_run_id| {
+        (
+            "signed".to_string(),
+            deadreckon_core::tamper::AcceptanceTamperVerdict::Clean,
+            Vec::new(),
+        )
+    });
+
+    let report = commands::campaign::campaign_why_failed_report(&paths, &campaign, Some(&rollup));
+
+    assert!(report.contains("session limit"), "{report}");
+    assert!(report.contains(&campaign.sub_goals[0].sub_id), "{report}");
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn provider_quota_note_extracts_reset_phrase() {
+    let note = provider_quota_note(QUOTA_REASON).expect("quota recognized");
+    assert!(note.contains("resets 10:50pm"), "{note}");
+
+    assert!(provider_quota_note("provider error: connection refused").is_none());
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn doctor_hint_suppressed_when_error_already_carries_try_line() {
+    let with_try = CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::user_error(
+        "campaign failed: refused sub(s) sub-0",
+        "deadreckon show 65a65820 --why-failed",
+    ));
+    assert_eq!(error_hint(&with_try), "");
+
+    let without_try = CliError::Core(deadreckon_core::error::DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
+        "something unmatched went wrong".to_string(),
+    ));
+    assert!(error_hint(&without_try).contains("doctor"));
+}

+/// First non-empty line of a failed run's stored failure reason, for
+/// bubbling into the plan- and campaign-level refusal surfaces that today
+/// only report their own layer's status.
+fn child_failure_reason(paths: &DeadreckonPaths, run_id: &str) -> Option<String> {
+    let entry = deadreckon_core::state::list_runs(paths, None)
+        .ok()?
+        .into_iter()
+        .find(|run| run.run_id == run_id)?;
+    let state = deadreckon_core::state::load_state(&entry.state_path).ok()?;
+    let reason = state.failure_reason.or(state.pause_reason)?;
+    let line = reason.lines().find(|line| !line.trim().is_empty())?.trim();
+    Some(if line.chars().count() > 200 {
+        let mut clipped: String = line.chars().take(200).collect();
+        clipped.push('…');
+        clipped
+    } else {
+        line.to_string()
+    })
+}
+
+/// A failure reason naming a provider session/usage/rate limit is resumable
+/// once the limit resets — surface that instead of a generic failure.
+fn provider_quota_note(reason: &str) -> Option<String> {
+    let lower = reason.to_lowercase();
+    let quota = ["session limit", "usage limit", "rate limit", "quota"]
+        .iter()
+        .any(|marker| lower.contains(marker));
+    if !quota {
+        return None;
+    }
+    let resets = reason
+        .lines()
+        .flat_map(|line| line.split('\u{b7}'))
+        .map(str::trim)
+        .find(|part| part.to_lowercase().starts_with("resets"));
+    Some(match resets {
+        Some(resets) => format!("provider limit hit; {resets}"),
+        None => "provider limit hit; resumable after it resets".to_string(),
+    })
+}

699	    let sub = campaign.sub_goals.iter().find(|sub| sub.sub_id == sub_id)?;
700	    // sub_plan_id is only persisted on merge; a refused sub's plan id lives in

329	                task_status_label(task.status)
330	            ),
331	            why,
332	            evidence,
333	        ),
334	        [("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
335	        secondary
336	            .iter()
337	            .map(|command| ("Secondary", command.as_str())),
338	    )
339	}

232	pub fn build_sub_goals(goals: Vec<String>, requested_n: usize) -> Result<Vec<SubGoal>> {
233	    if goals.len() != requested_n {
234	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
235	            "campaign planner returned {} sub-goals; expected exactly {requested_n}",
236	            goals.len()
237	        )));
238	    }
239	    validate_task_count(goals.len())?;
240	    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
241	    let mut subs = Vec::with_capacity(goals.len());
242	    for (index, goal) in goals.into_iter().enumerate() {
243	        let trimmed = goal.trim();
244	        if trimmed.is_empty() {
245	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
246	                "campaign sub-goal must not be empty".to_string(),
247	            ));
248	        }
249	        let normalized = trimmed
250	            .split_whitespace()
251	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
252	            .join(" ")
253	            .to_ascii_lowercase();
254	        if !seen.insert(normalized) {
255	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
256	                "duplicate campaign sub-goal: {trimmed}"
257	            )));
258	        }
259	        subs.push(SubGoal {
260	            sub_id: format!("sub-{index}"),
261	            goal: trimmed.to_string(),
262	            task_key: crate::paths::task_key(trimmed),
263	            sub_plan_id: None,
264	            result_run_id: None,
265	            scope: None,
266	            status: SubGoalStatus::Pending,
267	        });
268	    }
269	    Ok(subs)
270	}

301	    VerdictSurface::must_new(
302	        VerdictKind::Blocked,
303	        "chain narrative",
304	        Some(run_ref),
305	        ExplanationPanel::new(
306	            "Chain narrative attach is not supported yet.",
307	            "Narrative attach currently supports runs, plans, and plan child refs; chain status is the supported chain inspection path.",
308	            vec![
309	                ("chain", run_ref),
310	                ("view", "narrative"),
311	                ("supported narrative targets", "run, plan, plan child"),
312	            ],
313	        ),
314	        vec![("Recommended", primary.as_str())],
315	        vec![
316	            ("Secondary", "deadreckon attach <run-id> --view narrative"),
317	            ("Secondary", "deadreckon attach <plan-id> --view narrative"),
318	        ],
319	    )
320	}

322	async fn attach_campaign_tui(
323	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
324	    mut state: commands::campaign::CampaignAttachState,
325	    show_hints: bool,
326	    initial_view: AttachViewMode,
327	    initial_visual: NarrativeVisualMode,
328	    narrative_config: NarrativeAttachConfig,
329	) -> Result<()> {
330	    enable_raw_mode()?;
331	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
332	    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, EnableMouseCapture)?;
333	    let backend = CrosstermBackend::new(stdout);
334	    let mut terminal = Terminal::new(backend)?;
335	    let mut feed = commands::campaign::CampaignEventFeed::new(
336	        paths.clone(),
337	        state.campaign_dir.clone(),
338	        state.campaign.campaign_id.clone(),
339	    );
340	
341	    let mut show_help = false;
342	    let result = loop {
343	        let mut tick = AttachTickTiming::new(AttachSurface::Campaign, AttachTickBudget::default());
344	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
345	        let events = feed.refresh(Duration::ZERO).await;
346	        state.apply_feed_events(events);
347	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::EventFeed, stage_started);
348	
349	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
350	        if let Err(error) = state.refresh(paths) {
351	            state
352	                .feed
353	                .push_back(commands::campaign::CampaignFeedEvent::Warning {
354	                    message: format!("campaign refresh failed: {error}"),
355	                });
356	        }
357	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::LoadState, stage_started);
358	
359	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
360	        terminal.draw(|frame| {
361	            render_campaign_attach(frame, &state);
362	            if show_help {
363	                render_help_overlay(frame, AttachHelpMode::Campaign);
364	            }
365	        })?;
366	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::Draw, stage_started);
367	
368	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
369	        let input_ready = event::poll(Duration::from_millis(250))?;
370	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::InputPoll, stage_started);
371	        drop(tick.slow_sync_stages());
372	        drop(tick.slow_stage_labels());
373	        let _ = tick.frame_exceeded();
374	
375	        if input_ready && let Event::Key(key) = event::read()? {
376	            match handle_help_key(show_help, key) {
377	                HelpKeyAction::Open => {
378	                    show_help = true;
379	                    continue;
380	                }
381	                HelpKeyAction::Close => {
382	                    show_help = false;
383	                    continue;
384	                }
385	                HelpKeyAction::NotHandled => {}
386	            }
387	            match handle_campaign_key(&mut state, key) {
388	                CampaignAttachKeyAction::None | CampaignAttachKeyAction::Refresh => {}
389	                CampaignAttachKeyAction::Back | CampaignAttachKeyAction::Quit => break Ok(()),
390	                CampaignAttachKeyAction::DrillInto { sub_id, plan_id } => {
391	                    if load_plan(paths, &plan_id).is_err() {
392	                        state
393	                            .feed
394	                            .push_back(commands::campaign::CampaignFeedEvent::Warning {
395	                                message: format!("sub-plan {sub_id} unavailable: {plan_id}"),
396	                            });
397	                        continue;
398	                    }
399	                    suspend_tui(&mut terminal)?;
400	                    let parent_campaign = AttachCampaignParent {
401	                        campaign_id: state.campaign.campaign_id.clone(),
402	                        sub_id,
403	                    };
404	                    let child_result = attach_plan_tui(
405	                        paths,
406	                        &plan_id,
407	                        show_hints,
408	                        initial_view,
409	                        initial_visual,
410	                        narrative_config.clone(),
411	                        Some(parent_campaign),
412	                    )
413	                    .await;
414	                    if let Err(err) = &child_result {
415	                        print_error(err);
416	                        let _ =
417	                            wait_for_return("press Enter/q/Esc to return to campaign attach...");
418	                    }
419	                    resume_tui(&mut terminal)?;
420	                }
421	            }
422	        }
423	    };
424	
425	    disable_raw_mode()?;
426	    execute!(
427	        terminal.backend_mut(),
428	        DisableMouseCapture,
429	        LeaveAlternateScreen
430	    )?;
431	    terminal.show_cursor()?;
432	    result
433	}

435	async fn attach_plan_tui(
436	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
437	    plan_id: &str,
438	    show_hints: bool,
439	    initial_view: AttachViewMode,
440	    initial_visual: NarrativeVisualMode,
441	    narrative_config: NarrativeAttachConfig,
442	    parent_campaign: Option<AttachCampaignParent>,
443	) -> Result<()> {
444	    enable_raw_mode()?;
445	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
446	    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, EnableMouseCapture)?;
447	    let backend = CrosstermBackend::new(stdout);
448	    let mut terminal = Terminal::new(backend)?;
449	    let mut selected = 0_usize;
450	    let mut plan = load_plan(paths, plan_id)?;
451	    let mut messages: Vec<PlanMessage>;
452	    let mut plan_events = Vec::<PlanEvent>::new();
453	    let mut feed_events = Vec::<PlanFeedEvent>::new();
454	    let mut feed = PlanEventBus::file_tail(paths.clone(), plan_id.to_string());
455	    let mut view = initial_view;
456	    let mut visual = initial_visual;
457	    let mut narrative_scroll = 0_usize;
458	    let mut narrative_notice = None;
459	    let mut quiet_tracker = NarrativeQuietRefreshTracker::new(Utc::now());
460	    let mut narrative_refresh_job: Option<AttachPlanNarrativeRefreshJob> = None;
461	    let mut narrative_projection_cache = AttachNarrativeProjectionCache::default();
462	    let mut show_help = false;
463	
464	    let result = loop {
465	        let mut tick = AttachTickTiming::new(AttachSurface::Plan, AttachTickBudget::default());
466	        let now = Utc::now();
467	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
468	        let new_feed_events = feed.refresh(Duration::ZERO).await;
469	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::EventFeed, stage_started);
470	        let event_refresh = plan_narrative_refresh_trigger(&new_feed_events);
471	        quiet_tracker.observe_event_trigger(event_refresh, now);
472	        for event in new_feed_events {
473	            match event {
474	                PlanFeedEvent::Plan { event } => {
475	                    plan_events.push(event.clone());
476	                    feed_events.push(PlanFeedEvent::Plan { event });
477	                }
478	                PlanFeedEvent::Snapshot { plan: snapshot } => {
479	                    plan = (*snapshot).clone();
480	                    feed_events.push(PlanFeedEvent::Snapshot { plan: snapshot });
481	                }
482	                other => feed_events.push(other),
483	            }
484	        }
485	        if plan_events.len() > 1_000 {
486	            let drain = plan_events.len().saturating_sub(1_000);
487	            plan_events.drain(0..drain);
488	        }
489	        if feed_events.len() > 1_000 {
490	            let drain = feed_events.len().saturating_sub(1_000);
491	            feed_events.drain(0..drain);
492	        }
493	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
494	        messages = read_plan_messages(paths, plan_id).unwrap_or_default();
495	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::PlanMessages, stage_started);
496	        if let Some(notice) = poll_plan_narrative_refresh_job(&mut narrative_refresh_job).await {
497	            narrative_projection_cache.invalidate();
498	            narrative_notice = Some(notice);
499	        }
500	        if selected >= plan.tasks.len() {
501	            selected = plan.tasks.len().saturating_sub(1);
502	        }
503	        let auto_refresh = event_refresh.or_else(|| {
504	            if view.is_narrative() {
505	                quiet_tracker.maybe_trigger(
506	                    plan.status == PlanStatus::Forked,
507	                    narrative::NarrativeCadence::default().quiet_seconds,
508	                    now,
509	                )
510	            } else {
511	                None
512	            }
513	        });
514	        if let Some(kind) = auto_refresh
515	            && view.is_narrative()
516	        {
517	            let stage_started = Instant::now();
518	            let refresh_input = PlanNarrativeRefreshInput {
519	                paths,
520	                plan: &plan,
521	                messages: &messages,
522	                plan_events: &plan_events,
523	                feed_events: &feed_events,
524	                selected,
525	                config: &narrative_config,
526	            };
527	            narrative_notice = Some(start_or_coalesce_plan_narrative_refresh_job(
528	                &mut narrative_refresh_job,
529	                plan_narrative_refresh_request(&refresh_input, kind),
530	                now,
531	            ));
532	            tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::ProviderNarrativeRefresh, stage_started);
533	        }
534	        let narrative_projection = if view.is_narrative() {
535	            let input = narrative::PlanNarrativeInput {
536	                paths,
537	                plan: &plan,
538	                messages: &messages,
539	                plan_events: &plan_events,
540	                feed_events: &feed_events,
541	                selected,
542	            };
543	            narrative_projection_cache
544	                .refresh_plan(&input)
545	                .or_else(|_| Ok::<_, CliError>(narrative::build_plan_projection(&input)))
546	                .ok()
547	        } else {
548	            None
549	        };
550	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
551	        terminal.draw(|frame| {
552	            render_plan_attach(
553	                frame,
554	                paths,
555	                &plan,
556	                &PlanAttachRenderState {
557	                    messages: &messages,
558	                    plan_events: &plan_events,
559	                    feed_events: &feed_events,
560	                    selected,
561	                    show_hints,
562	                    view,
563	                    visual,
564	                    campaign_parent: parent_campaign.as_ref(),
565	                    narrative_notice: narrative_notice.as_deref(),
566	                    narrative_projection: narrative_projection.as_ref(),
567	                    narrative_scroll,
568	                },
569	            );
570	            if show_help {
571	                render_help_overlay(frame, AttachHelpMode::Plan);
572	            }
573	        })?;
574	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::Draw, stage_started);
575	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
576	        let input_ready = event::poll(Duration::from_millis(250))?;
577	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::InputPoll, stage_started);
578	        drop(tick.slow_sync_stages());
579	        drop(tick.slow_stage_labels());
580	        let _ = tick.frame_exceeded();
581	        if input_ready {
582	            let event = event::read()?;
583	            if let Event::Key(key) = event {
584	                match handle_help_key(show_help, key) {
585	                    HelpKeyAction::Open => {
586	                        show_help = true;
587	                        continue;
588	                    }
589	                    HelpKeyAction::Close => {
590	                        show_help = false;
591	                        continue;
592	                    }
593	                    HelpKeyAction::NotHandled => {}
594	                }
595	            }
596	            match event {
597	                Event::Key(key) if attach_should_quit(key) => break Ok(()),
598	                Event::Key(key) if key.code == KeyCode::Char('n') && key.modifiers.is_empty() => {
599	                    view = toggle_attach_view(view);
600	                    narrative_scroll = 0;
601	                }
602	                Event::Key(key) if key.code == KeyCode::Char('v') && key.modifiers.is_empty() => {
603	                    visual = visual.next();
604	                }
605	                Event::Key(key) if key.code == KeyCode::Char('r') && key.modifiers.is_empty() => {
606	                    view = AttachViewMode::Narrative;
607	                    let stage_started = Instant::now();
608	                    let refresh_input = PlanNarrativeRefreshInput {
609	                        paths,
610	                        plan: &plan,
611	                        messages: &messages,
612	                        plan_events: &plan_events,
613	                        feed_events: &feed_events,
614	                        selected,
615	                        config: &narrative_config,
616	                    };
617	                    narrative_notice = Some(start_or_coalesce_plan_narrative_refresh_job(
618	                        &mut narrative_refresh_job,
619	                        plan_narrative_refresh_request(
620	                            &refresh_input,
621	                            NarrativeRefreshKind::Manual,
622	                        ),
623	                        Utc::now(),
624	                    ));
625	                    tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::ProviderNarrativeRefresh, stage_started);
626	                    // No redundant immediate redraw: the loop redraws at the top of the
627	                    // next iteration (which begins right after input handling), and the
628	                    // background refresh job invalidates the narrative cache on completion.
629	                }
630	                Event::Key(key) if key.code == KeyCode::Enter => {
631	                    if let Some(run_id) = plan
632	                        .tasks
633	                        .get(selected)
634	                        .and_then(|task| task.child_run_id.as_deref())
635	                    {
636	                        if load_run(paths, run_id).is_err() {
637	                            narrative_notice = Some(unloadable_child_notice(run_id));
638	                            continue;
639	                        }
640	                        let parent_plan = plan.tasks.get(selected).map(|task| AttachParentPlan {
641	                            plan_id: plan.plan_id.clone(),
642	                            task_id: task.task_id.clone(),
643	                            campaign_parent: parent_campaign.clone(),
644	                        });
645	                        if cancel_plan_narrative_refresh_job(&mut narrative_refresh_job) {
646	                            narrative_notice = Some(
647	                                "plan refresh cancelled while opening child attach".to_string(),
648	                            );
649	                        }
650	                        suspend_tui(&mut terminal)?;
651	                        let child_result = attach_tui_with_parent(
652	                            paths,
653	                            run_id,
654	                            show_hints,
655	                            parent_plan,
656	                            view,
657	                            visual,
658	                            narrative_config.clone(),
659	                        )
660	                        .await;
661	                        if let Err(err) = &child_result {
662	                            print_error(err);
663	                            let _ =
664	                                wait_for_return("press Enter/q/Esc to return to plan attach...");
665	                        }
666	                        resume_tui(&mut terminal)?;
667	                    }
668	                }
669	                Event::Key(key) if view.is_narrative() => {
670	                    let total = narrative_projection.as_ref().map_or(0, |projection| {
671	                        let mut lines = narrative::narrative_plain_lines(projection, visual).len();
672	                        if narrative_notice.is_some() {
673	                            lines += 1;
674	                        }
675	                        lines
676	                    });
677	                    let rows =
678	                        usize::from(crate::tui::PLAN_NARRATIVE_AREA_HEIGHT.saturating_sub(2));
679	                    let mut nav = NarrativeScrollNav {
680	                        scroll: &mut narrative_scroll,
681	                        max: total.saturating_sub(rows),
682	                    };
683	                    crate::tui::navigation::dispatch_navigation(&mut nav, key);
684	                }
685	                Event::Key(key) => {
686	                    let mut nav = PlanNav {
687	                        selected: &mut selected,
688	                        count: plan.tasks.len(),
689	                    };
690	                    crate::tui::navigation::dispatch_navigation(&mut nav, key);
691	                }
692	                _ => {}
693	            }
694	        }
695	    };
696	
697	    cancel_plan_narrative_refresh_job(&mut narrative_refresh_job);
698	    disable_raw_mode()?;
699	    execute!(
700	        terminal.backend_mut(),
701	        DisableMouseCapture,
702	        LeaveAlternateScreen
703	    )?;
704	    terminal.show_cursor()?;
705	    result
706	}
707	
708	async fn attach_tui(
709	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
710	    run_id: &str,
711	    show_completion_actions: bool,
712	    initial_view: AttachViewMode,
713	    initial_visual: NarrativeVisualMode,
714	    narrative_config: NarrativeAttachConfig,
715	) -> Result<()> {
716	    attach_tui_with_parent(
717	        paths,
718	        run_id,
719	        show_completion_actions,
720	        None,
721	        initial_view,
722	        initial_visual,
723	        narrative_config,
724	    )
725	    .await
726	}
727	
728	async fn attach_tui_with_parent(
729	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
730	    run_id: &str,
731	    show_completion_actions: bool,
732	    parent_plan: Option<AttachParentPlan>,
733	    initial_view: AttachViewMode,
734	    initial_visual: NarrativeVisualMode,
735	    narrative_config: NarrativeAttachConfig,
736	) -> Result<()> {
737	    let initial_state = load_run(paths, run_id)?;
738	    let mut event_feed =
739	        tui_events::TuiEventFeed::file_tail(initial_state.run_root.join(RUN_EVENTS_JSONL));
740	    let mut events = event_feed.refresh(std::time::Duration::ZERO).await?;
741	    enable_raw_mode()?;
742	    let mut stdout = io::stdout();
743	    execute!(stdout, EnterAlternateScreen, EnableMouseCapture)?;
744	    let backend = CrosstermBackend::new(stdout);
745	    let mut terminal = Terminal::new(backend)?;
746	    let mut tui_state = AttachTuiState {
747	        show_completion_actions,
748	        parent_plan,
749	        view: initial_view,
750	        visual: initial_visual,
751	        ..AttachTuiState::default()
752	    };
753	    let mut quiet_tracker = NarrativeQuietRefreshTracker::new(Utc::now());
754	    let mut acceptance_tracker = NarrativeAcceptanceRefreshTracker::default();
755	    let mut narrative_refresh_job: Option<AttachRunNarrativeRefreshJob> = None;
756	    let mut spend_tail =
757	        AttachJsonlTail::<SpendRecord>::new(initial_state.run_root.join("spend.jsonl"));
758	    let mut trace_tail =
759	        AttachJsonlTail::<TraceRecord>::new(initial_state.run_root.join("traces.jsonl"));
760	    let mut provider_activity_cache = AttachProviderActivityCache::new(&initial_state);
761	    let mut narrative_projection_cache = AttachNarrativeProjectionCache::default();
762	    let mut show_help = false;
763	
764	    let result = loop {
765	        let mut tick = AttachTickTiming::new(AttachSurface::Run, AttachTickBudget::default());
766	        let now = Utc::now();
767	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
768	        let state = load_run(paths, run_id)?;
769	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::LoadState, stage_started);
770	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
771	        spend_tail.reset_to_path(state.run_root.join("spend.jsonl"));
772	        trace_tail.reset_to_path(state.run_root.join("traces.jsonl"));
773	        let spend = spend_tail.refresh()?;
774	        let traces = trace_tail.refresh()?;
775	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::ReadJsonl, stage_started);
776	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
777	        let new_events = event_feed.refresh(std::time::Duration::ZERO).await?;
778	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::EventFeed, stage_started);
779	        let run_event_refresh = run_narrative_refresh_trigger(&new_events);
780	        events.extend(new_events);
781	        // Bound the in-memory activity history like the plan loop does (attach.rs:462):
782	        // the Activity panel only shows a window, and an unbounded Vec makes every
783	        // frame's line-build O(run length).
784	        if events.len() > 1_000 {
785	            let drain = events.len().saturating_sub(1_000);
786	            events.drain(0..drain);
787	        }
788	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
789	        let provider_activity = provider_activity_cache.refresh(&state);
790	        let live = collect_attach_live_with_provider_activity(&state, provider_activity);
791	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::LiveCollect, stage_started);
792	        let event_refresh =
793	            run_event_refresh.or_else(|| acceptance_tracker.observe(&live.acceptance));
794	        quiet_tracker.observe_event_trigger(event_refresh, now);
795	        if let Some(notice) = poll_run_narrative_refresh_job(&mut narrative_refresh_job).await {
796	            narrative_projection_cache.invalidate();
797	            tui_state.record_narrative_refresh(notice);
798	        }
799	        tui_state.narrative_projection = if tui_state.view.is_narrative() {
800	            let input = RunNarrativeRenderInput {
801	                state: &state,
802	                spend,
803	                traces,
804	                events: &events,
805	                live: &live,
806	                tui_state: &tui_state,
807	            };
808	            narrative_projection_cache
809	                .refresh_run(&input)
810	                .or_else(|_| Ok::<_, CliError>(build_run_narrative_projection(&input)))
811	                .ok()
812	        } else {
813	            None
814	        };
815	        let terminal_size = terminal.size()?;
816	        let terminal_area =
817	            ratatui::layout::Rect::new(0, 0, terminal_size.width, terminal_size.height);
818	        let panel_layout = attach_panel_layout(terminal_area);
819	        let panel_counts = attach_panel_counts(&state, spend, traces, &events, &live, &tui_state);
820	        tui_state.clamp(panel_counts, panel_layout.rows);
821	        let auto_refresh = event_refresh.or_else(|| {
822	            if tui_state.view.is_narrative() {
823	                quiet_tracker.maybe_trigger(
824	                    state.status == RunStatus::Executing,
825	                    narrative::NarrativeCadence::default().quiet_seconds,
826	                    now,
827	                )
828	            } else {
829	                None
830	            }
831	        });
832	        if let Some(kind) = auto_refresh
833	            && tui_state.view.is_narrative()
834	        {
835	            let stage_started = Instant::now();
836	            let input = RunNarrativeRenderInput {
837	                state: &state,
838	                spend,
839	                traces,
840	                events: &events,
841	                live: &live,
842	                tui_state: &tui_state,
843	            };
844	            let notice = start_or_coalesce_run_narrative_refresh_job(
845	                &mut narrative_refresh_job,
846	                run_narrative_refresh_request(paths, &input, &narrative_config, kind),
847	                now,
848	            );
849	            tui_state.record_narrative_refresh(notice);
850	            tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::ProviderNarrativeRefresh, stage_started);
851	        }
852	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
853	        terminal.draw(|frame| {
854	            render_attach(frame, &state, spend, traces, &events, &live, &tui_state);
855	            if show_help {
856	                render_help_overlay(frame, AttachHelpMode::Run);
857	            }
858	        })?;
859	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::Draw, stage_started);
860	
861	        let stage_started = Instant::now();
862	        let input_ready = event::poll(Duration::from_millis(200))?;
863	        tick.record_since(AttachLoopStage::InputPoll, stage_started);
864	        drop(tick.slow_sync_stages());
865	        drop(tick.slow_stage_labels());
866	        let _ = tick.frame_exceeded();
867	        if input_ready {
868	            let event = event::read()?;
869	            if let Event::Key(key) = event {
870	                match handle_help_key(show_help, key) {
871	                    HelpKeyAction::Open => {
872	                        show_help = true;
873	                        continue;
874	                    }
875	                    HelpKeyAction::Close => {
876	                        show_help = false;
877	                        continue;
878	                    }
879	                    HelpKeyAction::NotHandled => {}
880	                }
881	            }
882	            match event {
883	                Event::Key(key)
884	                    if tui_state.parent_plan.is_some() && attach_should_return_to_plan(key) =>
885	                {
886	                    break Ok(());
887	                }
888	                Event::Key(key) if attach_should_quit(key) => break Ok(()),

891	                }

894	                }
895	                Event::Key(key) if key.code == KeyCode::Char('r') && key.modifiers.is_empty() => {

898	                        state: &state,
899	                        spend,
900	                        traces,
901	                        events: &events,
902	                        live: &live,

909	                            &input,
910	                            &narrative_config,
911	                            NarrativeRefreshKind::Manual,
912	                        ),
913	                        Utc::now(),
914	                    );
915	                    tui_state.record_narrative_refresh(notice);
916	                    tick.record_since(
917	                        AttachLoopStage::ProviderNarrativeRefresh,
918	                        provider_stage_started,

921	                    // next iteration; the background refresh job invalidates the cache.

925	                        && key.modifiers.is_empty()

927	                {
928	                    if let Some(marker) = read_chain_step_marker(&state.working_dir)? {

930	                        let action =
931	                            commands::chain::chain_attach_command(paths, &marker.chain_id, false);

934	                        }
935	                        resume_tui(&mut terminal)?;

937	                }

939	                    if tui_state.show_completion_actions
940	                        && state.status == RunStatus::Completed =>
941	                {
942	                    if key.code == KeyCode::Char('d') && key.modifiers.is_empty() {
943	                        tui_state.toggle_docs();
944	                    } else {
945	                        match resolve_completion_key(key, tui_state.pending_confirm) {
946	                            CompletionKeyOutcome::Confirm(action) => {
947	                                tui_state.pending_confirm = Some(action);
948	                            }
949	                            CompletionKeyOutcome::Cancel => {
950	                                tui_state.pending_confirm = None;
951	                            }
952	                            CompletionKeyOutcome::Execute(action) => {
953	                                tui_state.pending_confirm = None;
954	                                if let Some(notice) =
955	                                    run_completion_action(&mut terminal, paths, &state, action)
956	                                        .await?
957	                                {
958	                                    tui_state.record_post_action(notice);
959	                                }
960	                            }
961	                            CompletionKeyOutcome::Ignored => {
962	                                tui_state.handle_key(key, panel_counts, panel_layout.rows);
963	                            }
964	                        }
965	                    }
966	                }
967	                Event::Key(key) => tui_state.handle_key(key, panel_counts, panel_layout.rows),
968	                Event::Mouse(mouse) => {
969	                    if let Some(panel) = panel_layout.panel_at(mouse.column, mouse.row) {
970	                        tui_state.focused_panel = panel;
971	                    }
972	                    match mouse.kind {
973	                        MouseEventKind::ScrollDown => {
974	                            tui_state.scroll_focused(3, panel_counts, panel_layout.rows)
975	                        }
976	                        MouseEventKind::ScrollUp => {
977	                            tui_state.scroll_focused(-3, panel_counts, panel_layout.rows)
978	                        }
979	                        _ => {}

981	                }

992	        LeaveAlternateScreen
993	    )?;
994	    terminal.show_cursor()?;

996	}

998	#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
999	enum CompletionKeyOutcome {
1000	    Ignored,
1001	    Execute(CompletionAction),
1002	    Confirm(CompletionAction),
1003	    Cancel,
1004	}
1005	
1006	/// Resolve a completion-overlay keystroke given any pending confirmation.
1007	/// Destructive actions (Apply/Abandon) require a two-step confirm: the action
1008	/// key arms `pending`, then `y` runs it and any other key cancels. Abandon is
1009	/// `x` so that `b` is unambiguously "back" (no longer overloaded with Abandon).
1010	fn resolve_completion_key(
1011	    key: KeyEvent,
1012	    pending: Option<CompletionAction>,
1013	) -> CompletionKeyOutcome {
1014	    if let Some(action) = pending {
1015	        return if key.code == KeyCode::Char('y') {
1016	            CompletionKeyOutcome::Execute(action)
1017	        } else {
1018	            CompletionKeyOutcome::Cancel
1019	        };
1020	    }
1021	    let action = match key.code {
1022	        KeyCode::Char('m') => CompletionAction::Materialize,
1023	        KeyCode::Char('e') => CompletionAction::Extend,
1024	        KeyCode::Char('a') => CompletionAction::Apply,
1025	        KeyCode::Char('x') => CompletionAction::Abandon,
1026	        KeyCode::Char('s') => CompletionAction::Show,
1027	        _ => return CompletionKeyOutcome::Ignored,
1028	    };
1029	    if action.is_destructive() {
1030	        CompletionKeyOutcome::Confirm(action)
1031	    } else {
1032	        CompletionKeyOutcome::Execute(action)
1033	    }
1034	}

1036	async fn run_completion_action(
1037	    terminal: &mut Terminal<CrosstermBackend<io::Stdout>>,
1038	    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
1039	    state: &deadreckon_core::PipelineState,
1040	    action: CompletionAction,
1041	) -> Result<Option<AttachActionNotice>> {
1042	    suspend_tui(terminal)?;
1043	    let action_result = match action {
1044	        CompletionAction::Materialize => prompt_materialize_action(paths, state),
1045	        CompletionAction::Extend => prompt_extend_action(state).await,
1046	        CompletionAction::Apply => super::lifecycle::apply_command(
1047	            state.run_id.clone(),
1048	            "squash".to_string(),
1049	            None,
1050	            false,
1051	            false,
1052	            false,
1053	            None,
1054	            false,
1055	        ),
1056	        CompletionAction::Abandon => {
1057	            super::lifecycle::abandon_command(state.run_id.clone(), false, false)
1058	        }
1059	        CompletionAction::Docs => {
1060	            Box::pin(super::doc::doc_command(super::doc::DocCommandArgs {
1061	                run_id: state.run_id.clone(),
1062	                kind: CliDocKind::Narrative,
1063	                export: None,
1064	                polish: false,
1065	                no_confirm: true,
1066	                force: false,
1067	                doc_skill: None,
1068	                doc_provider: None,
1069	                budget_cap: None,
1070	            }))
1071	            .await
1072	        }
1073	        CompletionAction::Show => {
1074	            show_command(&state.run_id, None, false, false, false, false, None)
1075	        }
1076	        CompletionAction::Quit => Ok(()),
1077	    };
1078	    if let Err(err) = &action_result {
1079	        print_error(err);
1080	        print_error_hint(err);
1081	    }
1082	    let _ = wait_for_return("press Enter/q/Esc to return to attach...");
1083	    resume_tui(terminal)?;
1084	    Ok(Some(AttachActionNotice {
1085	        action,
1086	        success: action_result.is_ok(),
1087	    }))
1088	}

1133	/// Keys that dismiss a "press Enter to return" prompt: Enter, q, Esc, or
1134	/// Backspace — uniform with the attach exit/return controls (Enter only used to
1135	/// be the sole accepted key).
1136	fn return_key_dismisses(key: KeyEvent) -> bool {
1137	    matches!(
1138	        key.code,
1139	        KeyCode::Enter | KeyCode::Esc | KeyCode::Backspace | KeyCode::Char('q')
1140	    )
1141	}

1143	/// Show `message` and wait for any return key instead of only Enter, so leaving
1144	/// a nested view is uniform across every attach surface.
1145	fn wait_for_return(message: &str) -> Result<()> {
1146	    print!("{message}");
1147	    io::stdout().flush()?;
1148	    enable_raw_mode()?;
1149	    let outcome = loop {
1150	        match event::read() {
1151	            Ok(Event::Key(key)) if return_key_dismisses(key) => break Ok(()),
1152	            Ok(_) => continue,
1153	            Err(err) => break Err(err.into()),
1154	        }
1155	    };
1156	    let _ = disable_raw_mode();
1157	    println!();
1158	    outcome
1159	}

1170	const PLAN_LIST_PAGE: usize = 10;
1171	
1172	/// Drives the plan attach task selection through the shared navigation core
1173	/// ([`crate::tui::navigation`]). Arrows/`jk`/`Tab` move the highlighted child by
1174	/// one; `PgUp`/`PgDn` page; `Home`/`End`/`g`/`G` jump to the first/last child —
1175	/// parity with the run panel.
1176	struct PlanNav<'a> {
1177	    selected: &'a mut usize,
1178	    count: usize,
1179	}
1180	
1181	impl crate::tui::navigation::NavigableSurface for PlanNav<'_> {
1182	    fn focus_next(&mut self) {
1183	        self.scroll_lines(1);
1184	    }
1185	
1186	    fn focus_previous(&mut self) {
1187	        self.scroll_lines(-1);
1188	    }
1189	
1190	    fn scroll_lines(&mut self, delta: isize) {
1191	        let max = self.count.saturating_sub(1) as isize;
1192	        *self.selected = (*self.selected as isize + delta).clamp(0, max) as usize;
1193	    }
1194	
1195	    fn scroll_page(&mut self, direction: isize) {
1196	        self.scroll_lines(direction.signum() * PLAN_LIST_PAGE as isize);
1197	    }
1198	
1199	    fn scroll_to_start(&mut self) {
1200	        *self.selected = 0;
1201	    }
1202	
1203	    fn scroll_to_end(&mut self) {
1204	        *self.selected = self.count.saturating_sub(1);
1205	    }
1206	
1207	    fn mode_key(&mut self, key: KeyEvent) -> bool {
1208	        match key.code {
1209	            KeyCode::Left => {
1210	                self.scroll_lines(-1);
1211	                true
1212	            }
1213	            KeyCode::Right => {
1214	                self.scroll_lines(1);
1215	                true
1216	            }
1217	            _ => false,
1218	        }
1219	    }
1220	}
1221	
1222	const PLAN_NARRATIVE_PAGE: usize = 5;
1223	
1224	/// Scrolls the plan narrative panel through the shared navigation core. The
1225	/// narrative is a single fixed-height window, so `Tab` is a no-op; arrows/`jk`
1226	/// scroll one line, `PgUp`/`PgDn` page, and `Home`/`End`/`g`/`G` jump to the
1227	/// first/last screen — parity with the run narrative panel. `max` is the
1228	/// largest in-bounds offset (`total - visible_rows`), so the window never
1229	/// scrolls past the final line.
1230	struct NarrativeScrollNav<'a> {
1231	    scroll: &'a mut usize,
1232	    max: usize,
1233	}
1234	
1235	impl crate::tui::navigation::NavigableSurface for NarrativeScrollNav<'_> {
1236	    fn scroll_lines(&mut self, delta: isize) {
1237	        let next = if delta.is_negative() {
1238	            self.scroll.saturating_sub(delta.unsigned_abs())
1239	        } else {
1240	            self.scroll.saturating_add(delta as usize)
1241	        };
1242	        *self.scroll = next.min(self.max);
1243	    }
1244	
1245	    fn scroll_page(&mut self, direction: isize) {
1246	        self.scroll_lines(direction.signum() * PLAN_NARRATIVE_PAGE as isize);
1247	    }
1248	
1249	    fn scroll_to_start(&mut self) {
1250	        *self.scroll = 0;
1251	    }
1252	
1253	    fn scroll_to_end(&mut self) {
1254	        *self.scroll = self.max;
1255	    }
1256	}

2. **`sub_failure_summary` (campaign.rs)** — Reads `sub_id` (always `sub-{index}` — validated in `build_sub_goals`), reads `plan_id` from either `sub.sub_plan_id` or the launch sidecar via `read_sub_result`. `paths.home().join("plans").join(&campaign.campaign_id).join("launch").join(sub_id)` — `campaign_id` is a generated UUID; `sub_id` is `sub-{n}`. No traversal vector. The `plan_id` from disk flows into `load_plan` → `paths.plan_json(plan_id)` — also internal.

3. **`provider_quota_note` (main.rs)** — Pure string matching on already-truncated (200 char) failure reason. Output is recommendation text; no shell/path/SQL sink.

4. **`error_hint` substring check (main.rs)** — `err.to_string().contains("\ntry: ")` to suppress doctor hint. No security boundary; the substring check is on a locally generated error string.

5. **`merge_incomplete_plan_surface` (merge.rs)** — Constructs CLI command strings (`deadreckon resume {child}`, `deadreckon show {child} --why-failed`) where `{child}` is `run_prefix(run_id)` from a stored UUID. No shell execution at this point — these are display text rendered to terminal/JSON.

**Trust boundaries:** This is a local CLI tool reading its own state files written by its own subprocesses on the user's machine. There is no external (network/HTTP/IPC-from-untrusted) input introduced by this diff. The new flows surface data the user already owns (failure reasons from their own runs) into terminal/JSON output that goes to the same user.

**Specific patterns checked & ruled out:**
- Path traversal via sub_id: blocked — sub_id is always `sub-{n}` literal.
- Path traversal via plan_id from sidecar: requires prior local write access (already owned).
- Sensitive-to-observability: failure reasons may contain provider URLs/messages, but the data was already in `state.json` on disk, and the sink is the same local user's terminal/JSON; no new trust boundary crossed.
- Sibling-path-gate parity: no auth/permission gate modified.
- Allowlist/registry fanout: not a security registry.
- Fail-open state drift: `error_hint` returning `""` is correct behavior when a specific hint already exists; not a security decision.
- DoS via failure_reason: bounded at 200 chars by `child_failure_reason`.
- Test files (`campaign_spawn_tests.rs`, `failure_surfacing_tests.rs`, `navigable_tests.rs`): excluded per instructions.
